An '''unidentified Bith musician''' performed a series of concerts on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Bith]] was playing an instrument similar to a [[Kloo horn/Legends|kloo horn]]. [[Painting/Legends|Posters]] were put up around [[Galactic City/Legends|the city]] in order to promote the [[Musician/Legends|musician's]] concerts. [[Hover taxi/Legends|Hover taxi]] advertisements were also used. The [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] caption read "''[[Concert Solo/Legends|Concert Solo]]''".<ref name="LT" />
